changelog: Voice Call Activities: Added an Activities button in the VC bar with a horizontally scrollable chat-bubble game launcher, stream-style join/watch/hide tiles so nobody is forced into a game screen or forced to restart, and 6 built-in online multiplayer games with lobbies (Chess, Checkers, Minesweeper Race, VexilloGuessr, 8-Ball Pool, and 2–4 player Quoridor).
